We appreciate your consideration of our services. Below is a detailed overview of the work we will be undertaking:

Electrical Safety: Our skilled tradespeople will safely disconnect and secure the existing electrical systems, ensuring a secure environment for all subsequent work.

Data Points: We will install 5 new data points to significantly enhance connectivity within your premises.

Additional Installations: Furthermore, we will install a pendant GPO and a dedicated power supply for a coffee machine, tailored to accommodate your specific requirements.

If you have any questions or would like to discuss any particular aspects of this overview, please feel free to reach out to us at your convenience.

We appreciate your consideration of our services for your electrical needs. Below, you will find a comprehensive overview of the work we will undertake:

1. Custom Site Main Switchboard

Our skilled tradespeople will install a tailored main switchboard designed to meet your specific power distribution requirements, ensuring optimal functionality and safety.

2. Meter Panel

We will expertly install a three-phase meter panel, complete with all necessary connections and labour, to facilitate efficient energy management.

3. Boundary Fuse Kit

We will provide and install a boundary fuse kit, which acts as a protective measure for your electrical system, enhancing safety and reliability.

4. Consumer Pillar Mains

The installation of a three-phase consumer main will be performed to ensure a reliable and efficient power supply to your property.

5. Pre Lay

This phase includes the pre-laying of:

*	Four 32mm heavy-duty mains conduits with draw wire
*	Four NBN conduits with draw wire

These preparatory steps will effectively set up your site for future connections, ensuring a smooth and efficient process.
